title: Create a bar chart
summary: A bar chart compares amounts between categories.
introduction: A bar chart compares amounts between categories. Your task: Add Wednesday with 4 books.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for create a bar chart

blocks.text: A bar chart compares amounts between categories. Chart.js pairs labels with the values in a dataset.
Use a browser project with Chart.js 4 installed. Each example creates its own canvas inside a sized holder. Package imports need your project build tool and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Create a bar chart

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createElement` makes a new element in memory. Append it to the document when you want it to appear.
`beginAtZero: true` includes zero on the numeric axis, which usually makes bar-length comparisons honest.
`maintainAspectRatio: false` lets the Chart.js canvas use the explicit height of its parent holder.

blocks.text: Two bars compare 3 books on Monday with 5 on Tuesday.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep label and data order in step. A swapped value tells the wrong story.
